entries.title: Psalms 52:1
segments: ¶<<To the Chief Musician. A Contemplation of David when Doeg the Edomite went and told Saul, and said to him, "David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.">> Why do you boast in evil, O mighty man? The goodness of God [endures] continually.

entries.title: Psalms 52:2
segments: Your tongue devises destruction, Like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

entries.title: Psalms 52:3
segments: You love evil more than good, Lying rather than speaking righteousness. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 52:4
segments: You love all devouring words, [You] deceitful tongue.

entries.title: Psalms 52:5
segments: God shall likewise destroy you forever; He shall take you away, and pluck you out of [your] dwelling place, And uproot you from the land of the living. Selah

entries.title: Psalms 52:6
segments: ¶The righteous also shall see and fear, And shall laugh at him, [saying],

entries.title: Psalms 52:7
segments: "Here is the man [who] did not make God his strength, But trusted in the abundance of his riches, [And] strengthened himself in his wickedness."

entries.title: Psalms 52:8
segments: But I [am] like a green olive tree in the house of God; I trust in the mercy of God forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 52:9
segments: I will praise You forever, Because You have done [it]; And in the presence of Your saints I will wait on Your name, for [it is] good.
